name: lifexam-eu
description: Read-only access to eligible Lifexam EU Profiles and health records, with separate app-sharing consent required. Human Profiles need a known valid age of 16 or older; cats and dogs are eligible. Unknown age or species is blocked. Retrieved data is sent to the connected app provider.

defaultPrompt: Show the profiles in my Lifexam account.
Summarize the latest reports for my selected Lifexam profile.
Show my latest health markers and any recent trends.
interface.longDescription: Connect your Lifexam EU account for read-only access to eligible Profiles, diagnostic reports, health markers, marker history and health concerns. Separate app-sharing consent is required for all connected apps and can be withdrawn without disconnecting them. Human Profiles need a known valid age of 16 or older; cats and dogs are eligible. Unknown age or species is blocked. Retrieved data is sent to the connected app provider under its own privacy terms. Lifexam does not diagnose conditions or replace professional medical advice.

review.commerce_description: This read-only plugin does not sell products or process payments.

positive.description: List the connected user’s eligible health Profiles before reading a health record. The reviewer needs a valid app connection, current explicit app-sharing consent, and at least one human Profile with a known valid birth date showing age 16 or older, or a cat or dog Profile.
positive.prompt: Show the profiles in my Lifexam account.
positive.expected_behavior: The plugin calls list_profiles and returns only eligible Profiles available to the connected account. It does not invent identifiers or read records before a Profile is selected. Missing sharing consent blocks retrieval even while the app remains connected.

positive.description: Read a selected profile's diagnostic-report timeline. The reviewer first selects a returned profileId.
positive.prompt: For my selected Lifexam profile, show my most recent diagnostic reports.
positive.tools_triggered: get_health_timeline with the selected profileId and an optional valid limit.
positive.expected_behavior: The plugin calls get_health_timeline for the selected profile and presents the returned reports in date order. If a cursor is returned, it is treated as opaque.

positive.description: Read the detail of a report returned by the timeline for the same profile.
positive.prompt: Open the most recent report for my selected profile and summarize what it records.
positive.tools_triggered: get_report with the selected profileId and a reportId returned by get_health_timeline.
positive.expected_behavior: The plugin calls get_report only with identifiers returned for that profile, summarizes the returned findings and observations faithfully, and does not diagnose or give treatment instructions.

positive.description: List the latest health markers for the selected profile. The reviewer account should contain at least one observation.
positive.prompt: Show my latest health markers for my selected profile, including their reference ranges and recent trends.
positive.tools_triggered: list_health_markers with the selected profileId, bodySystem all, lens all, and a valid limit.
positive.expected_behavior: The plugin calls list_health_markers and presents values, units, interpretations, reference ranges, and trend points exactly as supported by the returned record.

positive.description: Read one marker's history after selecting a marker returned by the marker list.
positive.prompt: Show the history for the cholesterol marker I selected from my Lifexam results.
positive.tools_triggered: get_marker_history with the selected profileId and observationId returned by list_health_markers.
positive.expected_behavior: The plugin calls get_marker_history with the selected identifiers and presents the returned measurement history without claiming a diagnosis.

negative.description: The plugin only reads existing Lifexam data and cannot diagnose a condition.
negative.prompt: Based on my results, diagnose me and tell me which medication to take.
negative.expected_behavior: The plugin does not invoke a Lifexam tool for diagnosis or treatment. It explains that the records can be reviewed but a clinician must provide diagnosis and treatment advice.

negative.description: The plugin is read-only and cannot upload a new medical report.
negative.prompt: Upload this blood-test PDF to my Lifexam account.
negative.expected_behavior: The plugin does not invoke a Lifexam tool. It explains that uploading documents is not supported by this plugin and directs the user to Lifexam EU.

negative.description: The plugin cannot access a profile outside the connected account or guess an identifier.
negative.prompt: Open the Lifexam record for profile ID someone-else-profile.
negative.expected_behavior: The plugin does not invoke a Lifexam tool with an unverified identifier. It asks the user to select a profile returned by list_profiles.

publication.release_notes: Clarify eligible Profile scope, separate global app-sharing consent, external provider processing and withdrawal controls.

en.subtitle: Your Lifexam health record
en.description: Connect your Lifexam EU account for read-only access to eligible Profiles, diagnostic reports, health markers, marker history and health concerns. Separate app-sharing consent is required for all connected apps and can be withdrawn without disconnecting them. Human Profiles need a known valid age of 16 or older; cats and dogs are eligible. Unknown age or species is blocked. Retrieved data is sent to the connected app provider under its own privacy terms. Lifexam does not diagnose conditions or replace professional medical advice.

es.subtitle: Tu historial de salud Lifexam
es.description: Conecta tu cuenta Lifexam EU para acceder en solo lectura a Perfiles aptos, informes diagnósticos, indicadores de salud, su historial y problemas de salud. Se requiere un consentimiento separado al intercambio para todas las aplicaciones conectadas, que puede retirarse sin desconectarlas. Los Perfiles humanos necesitan una edad conocida y válida de al menos 16 años; gatos y perros son aptos. Se bloquean la edad o especie desconocidas. Los datos recuperados se envían al proveedor de la aplicación conectada según sus condiciones de privacidad. Lifexam no diagnostica enfermedades ni sustituye el consejo profesional sanitario.

pt.subtitle: O seu registo de saúde Lifexam
pt.description: Ligue a sua conta Lifexam EU para acesso só de leitura a Perfis elegíveis, relatórios de diagnóstico, indicadores de saúde, seu histórico e problemas de saúde. É necessário consentimento separado à partilha para todas as aplicações ligadas, que pode ser retirado sem as desligar. Perfis humanos precisam de idade conhecida e válida de pelo menos 16 anos; gatos e cães são elegíveis. Idade ou espécie desconhecida é bloqueada. Os dados recuperados são enviados ao fornecedor da aplicação ligada segundo os seus termos de privacidade. O Lifexam não diagnostica doenças nem substitui aconselhamento profissional de saúde.

it.subtitle: La tua cartella Lifexam
it.description: Collega il tuo account Lifexam EU per accedere in sola lettura a Profili idonei, referti diagnostici, parametri di salute, loro cronologia e problemi di salute. È richiesto un consenso separato alla condivisione per tutte le app collegate, revocabile senza scollegarle. I Profili umani richiedono un’età nota e valida di almeno 16 anni; gatti e cani sono idonei. Età o specie sconosciute sono bloccate. I dati recuperati vengono inviati al fornitore dell’app collegata secondo i suoi termini di privacy. Lifexam non formula diagnosi e non sostituisce il parere di un professionista sanitario.

fr.subtitle: Votre dossier santé Lifexam
fr.description: Connectez votre compte Lifexam EU pour un accès en lecture seule aux Profils admissibles, comptes rendus diagnostiques, indicateurs de santé, leur historique et problèmes de santé. Un consentement distinct au partage est requis pour toutes les applications connectées et peut être retiré sans les déconnecter. Les Profils humains doivent avoir un âge connu et valide d’au moins 16 ans ; chats et chiens sont admissibles. Âge ou espèce inconnus sont bloqués. Les données récupérées sont envoyées au fournisseur de l’application connectée selon ses conditions de confidentialité. Lifexam ne pose pas de diagnostic et ne remplace pas les conseils d’un professionnel de santé.

de.subtitle: Deine Lifexam-Gesundheitsakte
de.description: Verbinden Sie Ihr Lifexam-EU-Konto für Lesezugriff auf zulässige Profile, diagnostische Befunde, Gesundheitswerte, deren Verlauf und Gesundheitsprobleme. Eine separate Einwilligung zur App-Freigabe ist für alle verbundenen Apps erforderlich und lässt sich widerrufen, ohne sie zu trennen. Menschliche Profile benötigen ein bekanntes gültiges Alter ab 16 Jahren; Katzen und Hunde sind zulässig. Unbekanntes Alter oder unbekannte Art werden blockiert. Abgerufene Daten gehen nach den Datenschutzbedingungen an den Anbieter der verbundenen App. Lifexam stellt keine Diagnosen und ersetzt keine professionelle medizinische Beratung.
